Tariff reform and the Commission

The Joint Electricity Regulatory Commission sets tariffs for Goa. The Commission held hearings in March, and the commission's staff published a draft order in April. A new commission for the smaller states was proposed in 2019 but never set up.

The Government of Goa has asked for lower tariffs for farmers. The government also wants a separate category for hotels. The State has argued that the cross-subsidy is too high.
